 Wendell Carter Jr. leads Magic in loss to Suns 
 by Garrett Ball | Magic Correspondent | Fri, Nov 6th 2026, 9:23am EST 
 Wendell Carter Jr. scored 27 points (10-12 FG, 2-2 3P, 5-6 FT) with 13 rebounds, two assists, and two stocks in the Magic’s 117-104 loss to the Suns. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Carter had quite the offensive showing on Thursday, bouncing back from two consecutive single-digit point outings. He’s continued his pattern of either scoring 20 or more, or 10 or less, in every game so far this season. Because of that pattern, despite four games with 10+ rebounds, this was also his first double-double.
